'''Weni Darooga''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic First Fleet|First Fleet]] living during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], who worked closely with [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Bey'wan Aygo]], overall commander of the First Fleet.<ref name="Galactic Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Darooga appears in the MMORPG [[Star Wars: The Old Republic]], where they send the player an in-game message explaining the role of Guild Flagships.

==Appearances==
